note: Representative published values (order-of-magnitude) for the scalar ranges below. For explicit published DATPOINTS with sources + caveats and a quantitative fit, see literature/*.toml (bridge_deneubourg.toml, caste_gordon.toml) and `--compare-lit` FIT section. Sources: Deneubourg/Goss Argentine-ant bridge (~1989); Gordon task-allocation (Pogonomyrmex); trail-pheromone decay literature; Wehner & Muller (1988) / Muller & Wehner (1988) Cataglyphis fortis path integration; insect-MB reviews (Perez-Orive et al.) on Kenyon-cell sparseness; Heisenberg & Gerber / Davis Drosophila MB associative learning. Definitions and species differ; tick<->physical time is undefined. Use as a sanity-scale / explicit-datapoint check, not a statistical fit.

metrics.name: bridge_short_path_fraction
metrics.lit_note: Deneubourg/Goss: colony converges ~80-90% on the shorter bridge

metrics.name: trail_pheromone_halflife
metrics.lit_note: real ant trail pheromone挥发; model tick<->s undefined

metrics.name: active_forager_fraction
metrics.lit_note: Gordon: ~20-40% actively foraging at a time (defn differs; model 'forager'=non-guard caste, not active-at-instant)

metrics.name: path_selection_via_stigmergy
metrics.lit_note: ACO: short path amplified by positive feedback

metrics.name: cx_path_integration_drift
metrics.lit_note: Cataglyphis fortis PI homing error scales ~linearly with distance; model is more accurate (no sensory noise) — see --bench-cx

metrics.name: cx_pi_direction_error
metrics.lit_note: desert-ant PI direction stays tight; model dir_err ~0 deg (clean compass injection)

metrics.name: mb_kc_sparsity
metrics.lit_note: insect MB Kenyon cells fire sparsely (Perez-Orive et al.); model KC_THRESH gates a sparse subset

metrics.name: mb_associative_learning
metrics.lit_note: Drosophila MB: PAM-DAN (reward) / PPL1-DAN (punishment) dual dopaminergic pathways gate KC->MBON plasticity (Heisenberg/Gerber); model: dual reward/punish dopamine channels gating LTP/LTD + AL->KC Hebbian plasticity + satiety (drive-dependent reward) modulation
